name: The Fool
waite_upright: Folly, mania, extravagance, intoxication, delirium, frenzy, bewrayment.
waite_reversed: Negligence, absence, distribution, carelessness, apathy, nullity, vanity.
golden_dawn_title: The Spirit of Aether

name: The Magician
waite_upright: Skill, diplomacy, address, subtlety; sickness, pain, loss, disaster, snares of enemies; self-confidence, will; the Querent, if male.
waite_reversed: Physician, Magus, mental disease, disgrace, disquiet.
golden_dawn_title: The Magus of Power

name: The High Priestess
waite_upright: Secrets, mystery, the future as yet unrevealed; the woman who interests the Querent, if male; the Querent herself, if female; silence, tenacity; mystery, wisdom, science.
waite_reversed: Passion, moral or physical ardour, conceit, surface knowledge.
golden_dawn_title: The Priestess of the Silver Star

name: The Empress
waite_upright: Fruitfulness, action, initiative, length of days; the unknown, clandestine; also difficulty, doubt, ignorance.
waite_reversed: Light, truth, the unravelling of involved matters, public rejoicings; according to another reading, vacillation.
golden_dawn_title: The Daughter of the Mighty Ones

name: The Emperor
waite_upright: Stability, power, protection, realization; a great person; aid, reason, conviction; also authority and will.
waite_reversed: Benevolence, compassion, credit; also confusion to enemies, obstruction, immaturity.
golden_dawn_title: Sun of the Morning, Chief among the Mighty

name: The Hierophant
waite_upright: Marriage, alliance, captivity, servitude; by another account, mercy and goodness; inspiration; the man to whom the Querent has recourse.
waite_reversed: Society, good understanding, concord, over-kindness, weakness.
golden_dawn_title: The Magus of the Eternal

name: The Lovers
waite_upright: Attraction, love, beauty, trials overcome.
waite_reversed: Failure, foolish designs. Another account speaks of marriage frustrated and contrarieties of all kinds.
golden_dawn_title: The Children of the Voice; the Oracles of the Mighty Gods

name: The Chariot
waite_upright: Succour, providence; also war, triumph, presumption, vengeance, trouble.
waite_reversed: Riot, quarrel, dispute, litigation, defeat.
golden_dawn_title: The Child of the Powers of the Waters; the Lord of the Triumph of Light

name: Strength
waite_upright: Power, energy, action, courage, magnanimity; also complete success and honours.
waite_reversed: Despotism, abuse of power, weakness, discord, sometimes even disgrace.
golden_dawn_title: The Daughter of the Flaming Sword

name: The Hermit
waite_upright: Prudence, circumspection; also and especially treason, dissimulation, roguery, corruption.
waite_reversed: Concealment, disguise, policy, fear, unreasoned caution.
golden_dawn_title: The Magus of the Voice of Power; the Prophet of the Eternal

name: Wheel of Fortune
waite_upright: Destiny, fortune, success, elevation, luck, felicity.
waite_reversed: Increase, abundance, superfluity.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of the Forces of Life

name: Justice
waite_upright: Equity, rightness, probity, executive; triumph of the deserving side in law.
waite_reversed: Law in all its departments, legal complications, bigotry, bias, excessive severity.
golden_dawn_title: The Daughter of the Lords of Truth; the Ruler of the Balance

name: The Hanged Man
waite_upright: Wisdom, circumspection, discernment, trials, sacrifice, intuition, divination, prophecy.
waite_reversed: Selfishness, the crowd, body politic.
golden_dawn_title: The Spirit of the Mighty Waters

name: Death
waite_upright: End, mortality, destruction, corruption; also, for a man, the loss of a benefactor; for a woman, many contrarieties; for a maid, failure of marriage projects.
waite_reversed: Inertia, sleep, lethargy, petrifaction, somnambulism; hope destroyed.
golden_dawn_title: The Child of the Great Transformers; the Lord of the Gates of Death

name: Temperance
waite_upright: Economy, moderation, frugality, management, accommodation.
waite_reversed: Things connected with churches, religions, sects, the priesthood, sometimes even the priest who will marry the Querent; also disunion, unfortunate combinations, competing interests.
golden_dawn_title: The Daughter of the Reconcilers; the Bringer-Forth of Life

name: The Devil
waite_upright: Ravage, violence, vehemence, extraordinary efforts, force, fatality; that which is predestined but is not for this reason evil.
waite_reversed: Evil fatality, weakness, pettiness, blindness.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of the Gates of Matter; the Child of the Forces of Time

name: The Tower
waite_upright: Misery, distress, indigence, adversity, calamity, disgrace, deception, ruin. It is a card in particular of unforeseen catastrophe.
waite_reversed: According to one account, the same in a lesser degree; also oppression, imprisonment, tyranny.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of the Hosts of the Mighty

name: The Star
waite_upright: Loss, theft, privation, abandonment; another reading says—hope and bright prospects,
waite_reversed: Arrogance, haughtiness, impotence.
golden_dawn_title: The Daughter of the Firmament; the Dweller between the Waters

name: The Moon
waite_upright: Hidden enemies, danger, calumny, darkness, terror, deception, occult forces, error.
waite_reversed: Instability, inconstancy, silence, lesser degrees of deception and error.
golden_dawn_title: The Ruler of Flux and Reflux; the Child of the Sons of the Mighty

name: The Sun
waite_upright: Material happiness, fortunate marriage, contentment.
waite_reversed: The same in a lesser sense.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of the Fire of the World

name: Judgement
waite_upright: Change of position, renewal, outcome. Another account specifies total loss though lawsuit.
waite_reversed: Weakness, pusillanimity, simplicity; also deliberation, decision, sentence.
golden_dawn_title: The Spirit of the Primal Fire

name: The World
waite_upright: Assured success, recompense, voyage, route, emigration, flight, change of place.
waite_reversed: Inertia, fixity, stagnation, permanence.
golden_dawn_title: The Great One of the Night of Time

name: Ace of Wands
waite_upright: Creation, invention, enterprise, the powers which result in these; principle, beginning, source; birth, family, origin, and in a sense the virility which is behind them; the starting point of enterprises; according to another account, money, fortune, inheritance.
waite_reversed: Fall, decadence, ruin, perdition, to perish; also a certain clouded joy.
golden_dawn_title: The Root of the Powers of Fire
waite_additional_upright: Calamities of all kinds.

name: Two of Wands
waite_upright: Between the alternative readings there is no marriage possible; on the one hand, riches, fortune, magnificence; on the other, physical suffering, disease, chagrin, sadness, mortification. The design gives one suggestion; here is a lord overlooking his dominion and alternately contemplating a globe; it looks like the malady, the mortification, the sadness of Alexander amidst the grandeur of this world's wealth.
waite_reversed: Surprise, wonder, enchantment, emotion, trouble, fear.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Dominion
waite_additional_upright: A young lady may expect trivial disappointments.

name: Three of Wands
waite_upright: He symbolizes established strength, enterprise, effort, trade, commerce, discovery; those are his ships, bearing his merchandise, which are sailing over the sea. The card also signifies able co-operation in business, as if the successful merchant prince were looking from his side towards yours with a view to help you.
waite_reversed: The end of troubles, suspension or cessation of adversity, toil and disappointment.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Established Strength
waite_additional_upright: A very good card; collaboration will favour enterprise.

name: Four of Wands
waite_upright: They are for once almost on the surface—country life, haven of refuge, a species of domestic harvest-home, repose, concord, harmony, prosperity, peace, and the perfected work of these.
waite_reversed: The meaning remains unaltered; it is prosperity, increase, felicity, beauty, embellishment.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Perfected Work
waite_additional_upright: Unexpected good fortune.
waite_additional_reversed: A married woman will have beautiful children.

name: Five of Wands
waite_upright: Imitation, as, for example, sham fight, but also the strenuous competition and struggle of the search after riches and fortune. In this sense it connects with the battle of life. Hence some attributions say that it is a card of gold, gain, opulence.
waite_reversed: Litigation, disputes, trickery, contradiction.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Strife
waite_additional_upright: Success in financial speculation.
waite_additional_reversed: Quarrels may be turned to advantage.

name: Six of Wands
waite_upright: The card has been so designed that it can cover several significations; on the surface, it is a victor triumphing, but it is also great news, such as might be carried in state by the King's courier; it is expectation crowned with its own desire, the crown of hope, and so forth.
waite_reversed: Apprehension, fear, as of a victorious enemy at the gate; treachery, disloyalty, as of gates being opened to the enemy; also indefinite delay.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Victory
waite_additional_upright: Servants may lose the confidence of their masters; a young lady may be betrayed by a friend.

name: Seven of Wands
waite_upright: It is a card of valour, for, on the surface, six are attacking one, who has, however, the vantage position. On the intellectual plane, it signifies discussion, wordy strife; in business—negotiations, war of trade, barter, competition. It is further a card of success, for the combatant is on the top and his enemies may be unable to reach him.
waite_reversed: Perplexity, embarrassments, anxiety. It is also a caution against indecision.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Valour
waite_additional_upright: A dark child.

name: Eight of Wands
waite_upright: Activity in undertakings, the path of such activity, swiftness, as that of an express messenger; great haste, great hope, speed towards an end which promises assured felicity; generally, that which is on the move; also the arrows of love.
waite_reversed: Arrows of jealousy, internal dispute, stingings of conscience, quarrels; and domestic disputes for persons who are married.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Swiftness
waite_additional_upright: Domestic disputes for a married person.

name: Nine of Wands
waite_upright: The card signifies strength in opposition. If attacked, the person will meet an onslaught boldly; and his build shews that he may prove a formidable antagonist. With this main significance there are all its possible adjuncts—delay, suspension, adjournment.
waite_reversed: Obstacles, adversity, calamity.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Great Strength
waite_additional_upright: Generally speaking, a bad card.

name: Ten of Wands
waite_upright: A card of many significances, and some of the readings cannot be harmonized. I set aside that which connects it with honour and good faith. The chief meaning is oppression simply, but it is also fortune, gain, any kind of success, and then it is the oppression of these things. It is also a card of false-seeming, disguise, perfidy. The place which the figure is approaching may suffer from the rods that he carries. Success is stultified if the Nine of Swords follows, and if it is a question of a lawsuit, there will be certain loss.
waite_reversed: Contrarieties, difficulties, intrigues, and their analogies.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Oppression
waite_additional_upright: Difficulties and contradictions, if near a good card.

name: Page of Wands
waite_upright: Dark young man, faithful, a lover, an envoy, a postman. Beside a man, he will bear favourable testimony concerning him. A dangerous rival, if followed by the Page of Cups. Has the chief qualities of his suit. He may signify family intelligence.
waite_reversed: Anecdotes, announcements, evil news. Also indecision and the instability which accompanies it.
golden_dawn_title: The Princess of the Shining Flame; the Rose of the Palace of Fire
waite_additional_upright: Young man of family in search of young lady.

name: Knight of Wands
waite_upright: Departure, absence, flight, emigration. A dark young man, friendly. Change of residence.
waite_reversed: Rupture, division, interruption, discord.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of the Flame and Lightning; the King of the Spirits of Fire
waite_additional_upright: A bad card; according to some readings, alienation.
waite_additional_reversed: For a woman, marriage, but probably frustrated.

name: Queen of Wands
waite_upright: A dark woman, countrywoman, friendly, chaste, loving, honourable. If the card beside her signifies a man, she is well disposed towards him; if a woman, she is interested in the Querent. Also, love of money, or a certain success in business.
waite_reversed: Good, economical, obliging, serviceable. Signifies also—but in certain positions and in the neighbourhood of other cards tending in such directions—opposition, jealousy, even deceit and infidelity.
golden_dawn_title: The Queen of the Thrones of Flame
waite_additional_upright: A good harvest, which may be taken in several senses.
waite_additional_reversed: Good-will towards the Querent, but without the opportunity to exercise it.

name: King of Wands
waite_upright: Dark man, friendly, countryman, generally married, honest and conscientious. The card always signifies honesty, and may mean news concerning an unexpected heritage to fall in before very long.
waite_reversed: Good, but severe; austere, yet tolerant.
golden_dawn_title: The Prince of the Chariot of Fire
waite_additional_upright: Generally favourable; may signify a good marriage.

name: Ace of Cups
waite_upright: House of the true heart, joy, content, abode, nourishment, abundance, fertility; Holy Table, felicity hereof.
waite_reversed: House of the false heart, mutation, instability, revolution.
golden_dawn_title: The Root of the Powers of Water
waite_additional_upright: Inflexible will, unalterable law.

name: Two of Cups
waite_upright: Love, passion, friendship, affinity, union, concord, sympathy, the interrelation of the sexes, and—as a suggestion apart from all offices of divination—that desire which is not in Nature, but by which Nature is sanctified.
waite_reversed: Passion.
waite_reversed_section: Part III §4 (additional meaning; §2 has no reversed line)
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Love
waite_additional_upright: Favourable in things of pleasure and business, as well as love; also wealth and honour.

name: Three of Cups
waite_upright: The conclusion of any matter in plenty, perfection and merriment; happy issue, victory, fulfilment, solace, healing.
waite_reversed: Expedition, dispatch, achievement, end. It signifies also the side of excess in physical enjoyment, and the pleasures of the senses.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Abundance
waite_additional_upright: Unexpected advancement for a military man.
waite_additional_reversed: Consolation, cure, end of the business.

name: Four of Cups
waite_upright: Weariness, disgust, aversion, imaginary vexations, as if the wine of this world had caused satiety only; another wine, as if a fairy gift, is now offered the wastrel, but he sees no consolation therein. This is also a card of blended pleasure.
waite_reversed: Novelty, presage, new instruction, new relations.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Blended Pleasure
waite_additional_upright: Contrarieties.

name: Five of Cups
waite_upright: It is a card of loss, but something remains over; three have been taken, but two are left; it is a card of inheritance, patrimony, transmission, but not corresponding to expectations; with some interpreters it is a card of marriage, but not without bitterness or frustration.
waite_reversed: News, alliances, affinity, consanguinity, ancestry, return, false projects.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Loss in Pleasure
waite_additional_upright: Generally favourable; a happy marriage; also patrimony, legacies, gifts, success in enterprise.
waite_additional_reversed: Return of some relative who has not been seen for long.

name: Six of Cups
waite_upright: A card of the past and of memories, looking back, as—for example—on childhood; happiness, enjoyment, but coming rather from the past; things that have vanished. Another reading reverses this, giving new relations, new knowledge, new environment, and then the children are disporting in an unfamiliar precinct.
waite_reversed: The future, renewal, that which will come to pass presently.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Pleasure
waite_additional_upright: Pleasant memories.

name: Seven of Cups
waite_upright: Fairy favours, images of reflection, sentiment, imagination, things seen in the glass of contemplation; some attainment in these degrees, but nothing permanent or substantial is suggested.
waite_reversed: Desire, will, determination, project.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Illusionary Success
waite_additional_upright: Fair child; idea, design, resolve, movement.
waite_additional_reversed: Success, if accompanied by the Three of Cups.

name: Eight of Cups
waite_upright: The card speaks for itself on the surface, but other readings are entirely antithetical—giving joy, mildness, timidity, honour, modesty. In practice, it is usually found that the card shews the decline of a matter, or that a matter which has been thought to be important is really of slight consequence—either for good or evil.
waite_reversed: Great joy, happiness, feasting.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Abandoned Success
waite_additional_upright: Marriage with a fair woman.

name: Nine of Cups
waite_upright: Concord, contentment, physical bien-être; also victory, success, advantage; satisfaction for the Querent or person for whom the consultation is made.
waite_reversed: Truth, loyalty, liberty; but the readings vary and include mistakes, imperfections, etc.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Material Happiness
waite_additional_upright: Of good augury for military men.

name: Ten of Cups
waite_upright: Contentment, repose of the entire heart; the perfection of that state; also perfection of human love and friendship; if with several picture-cards, a person who is taking charge of the Querent's interests; also the town, village or country inhabited by the Querent.
waite_reversed: Repose of the false heart, indignation, violence.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Perfected Success
waite_additional_upright: For a male Querent, a good marriage and one beyond his expectations.

name: Page of Cups
waite_upright: Fair young man, one impelled to render service and with whom the Querent will be connected; a studious youth; news, message; application, reflection, meditation; also these things directed to business.
waite_reversed: Taste, inclination, attachment, seduction, deception, artifice.
golden_dawn_title: The Princess of the Waters; the Lotus of the Palace of the Floods
waite_additional_upright: Good augury; also a young man who is unfortunate in love.

name: Knight of Cups
waite_upright: Arrival, approach—sometimes that of a messenger; advances, proposition, demeanour, invitation, incitement.
waite_reversed: Trickery, artifice, subtlety, swindling, duplicity, fraud.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of the Waves and the Waters; the King of the Hosts of the Sea
waite_additional_upright: A visit from a friend, who will bring unexpected money to the Querent.

name: Queen of Cups
waite_upright: Good, fair woman; honest, devoted woman, who will do service to the Querent; loving intelligence, and hence the gift of vision; success, happiness, pleasure; also wisdom, virtue; a perfect spouse and a good mother.
waite_reversed: The accounts vary; good woman; otherwise, distinguished woman but one not to be trusted; perverse woman; vice, dishonour, depravity.
golden_dawn_title: The Queen of the Thrones of the Waters
waite_additional_upright: Sometimes denotes a woman of equivocal character.
waite_additional_reversed: A rich marriage for a man and a distinguished one for a woman.

name: King of Cups
waite_upright: Fair man, man of business, law, or divinity; responsible, disposed to oblige the Querent; also equity, art and science, including those who profess science, law and art; creative intelligence.
waite_reversed: Dishonest, double-dealing man; roguery, exaction, injustice, vice, scandal, pillage, considerable loss.
golden_dawn_title: The Prince of the Chariot of the Waters
waite_additional_upright: Beware of ill-will on the part of a man of position, and of hypocrisy pretending to help.

name: Ace of Swords
waite_upright: Triumph, the excessive degree in everything, conquest, triumph of force. It is a card of great force, in love as well as in hatred. The crown may carry a much higher significance than comes usually within the sphere of fortune-telling.
waite_reversed: The same, but the results are disastrous; another account says—conception, childbirth, augmentation, multiplicity.
golden_dawn_title: The Root of the Powers of Air
waite_additional_upright: Great prosperity or great misery.
waite_additional_reversed: Marriage broken off, for a woman, through her own imprudence.

name: Two of Swords
waite_upright: Conformity and the equipoise which it suggests, courage, friendship, concord in a state of arms; another reading gives tenderness, affection, intimacy. The suggestion of harmony and other favourable readings must be considered in a qualified manner, as Swords generally are not symbolical of beneficent forces in human affairs.
waite_reversed: Imposture, falsehood, duplicity, disloyalty.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Peace Restored
waite_additional_upright: Gifts for a lady, influential protection for a man in search of help.

name: Three of Swords
waite_upright: Removal, absence, delay, division, rupture, dispersion, and all that the design signifies naturally, being too simple and obvious to call for specific enumeration.
waite_reversed: Mental alienation, error, loss, distraction, disorder, confusion.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Sorrow
waite_additional_upright: For a woman, the flight of her lover.
waite_additional_reversed: A meeting with one whom the Querent has compromised; also a nun.

name: Four of Swords
waite_upright: Vigilance, retreat, solitude, hermit's repose, exile, tomb and coffin. It is these last that have suggested the design.
waite_reversed: Wise administration, circumspection, economy, avarice, precaution, testament.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Rest from Strife
waite_additional_upright: A bad card, but if reversed a qualified success may be expected by wise administration of affairs.
waite_additional_reversed: A certain success following wise administration.

name: Five of Swords
waite_upright: Degradation, destruction, revocation, infamy, dishonour, loss, with the variants and analogues of these.
waite_reversed: The same; burial and obsequies.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Defeat
waite_additional_upright: An attack on the fortune of the Querent.
waite_additional_reversed: A sign of sorrow and mourning.

name: Six of Swords
waite_upright: Journey by water, route, way, envoy, commissionary, expedient.
waite_reversed: Declaration, confession, publicity; one account says that it is a proposal of love.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Earned Success
waite_additional_upright: The voyage will be pleasant.

name: Seven of Swords
waite_upright: Design, attempt, wish, hope, confidence; also quarrelling, a plan that may fail, annoyance. The design is uncertain in its import, because the significations are widely at variance with each other.
waite_reversed: Good advice, counsel, instruction, slander, babbling.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Unstable Effort
waite_additional_upright: Dark girl; a good card; it promises a country life after a competence has been secured.

name: Eight of Swords
waite_upright: Bad news, violent chagrin, crisis, censure, power in trammels, conflict, calumny; also sickness.
waite_reversed: Disquiet, difficulty, opposition, accident, treachery; what is unforeseen; fatality.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Shortened Force
waite_additional_upright: For a woman, scandal spread in her respect.

name: Nine of Swords
waite_upright: Death, failure, miscarriage, delay, deception, disappointment, despair.
waite_reversed: Imprisonment, suspicion, doubt, reasonable fear, shame.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Despair and Cruelty
waite_additional_upright: An ecclesiastic, a priest; generally, a card of bad omen.
waite_additional_reversed: Good ground for suspicion against a doubtful person.

name: Ten of Swords
waite_upright: Whatsoever is intimated by the design; also pain, affliction, tears, sadness, desolation. It is not especially a card of violent death.
waite_reversed: Advantage, profit, success, favour, but none of these are permanent; also power and authority.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Ruin
waite_additional_upright: Followed by Ace and King, imprisonment; for girl or wife, treason on the part of friends.
waite_additional_reversed: Victory and consequent fortune for a soldier in war.

name: Page of Swords
waite_upright: Authority, overseeing, secret service, vigilance, spying, examination, and the qualities thereto belonging.
waite_reversed: More evil side of these qualities; what is unforeseen, unprepared state; sickness is also intimated.
golden_dawn_title: The Princess of the Rushing Winds; the Lotus of the Palace of Air
waite_additional_upright: An indiscreet person will pry into the Querent's secrets.

name: Knight of Swords
waite_upright: Skill, bravery, capacity, defence, address, enmity, wrath, war, destruction, opposition, resistance, ruin. There is therefore a sense in which the card signifies death, but it carries this meaning only in its proximity to other cards of fatality.
waite_reversed: Imprudence, incapacity, extravagance.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of the Wind and the Breezes; the King of the Spirits of Air
waite_additional_upright: A soldier, man of arms, satellite, stipendiary; heroic action predicted for soldier.
waite_additional_reversed: Dispute with an imbecile person; for a woman, struggle with a rival, who will be conquered.

name: Queen of Swords
waite_upright: Widowhood, female sadness and embarrassment, absence, sterility, mourning, privation, separation.
waite_reversed: Malice, bigotry, artifice, prudery, bale, deceit.
golden_dawn_title: The Queen of the Thrones of Air
waite_additional_upright: A widow.
waite_additional_reversed: A bad woman, with ill-will towards the Querent.

name: King of Swords
waite_upright: Whatsoever arises out of the idea of judgment and all its connexions—power, command, authority, militant intelligence, law, offices of the crown, and so forth.
waite_reversed: Cruelty, perversity, barbarity, perfidy, evil intention.
golden_dawn_title: The Prince of the Chariot of the Winds
waite_additional_upright: A lawyer, senator, doctor.
waite_additional_reversed: A bad man; also a caution to put an end to a ruinous lawsuit.

name: Ace of Pentacles
waite_upright: Perfect contentment, felicity, ecstasy; also speedy intelligence; gold.
waite_reversed: The evil side of wealth, bad intelligence; also great riches. In any case it shews prosperity, comfortable material conditions, but whether these are of advantage to the possessor will depend on whether the card is reversed or not.
golden_dawn_title: The Root of the Powers of Earth
waite_additional_upright: The most favourable of all cards.
waite_additional_reversed: A share in the finding of treasure.

name: Two of Pentacles
waite_upright: On the one hand it is represented as a card of gaiety, recreation and its connexions, which is the subject of the design; but it is read also as news and messages in writing, as obstacles, agitation, trouble, embroilment.
waite_reversed: Enforced gaiety, simulated enjoyment, literal sense, handwriting, composition, letters of exchange.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Harmonious Change
waite_additional_upright: Troubles are more imaginary than real.

name: Three of Pentacles
waite_upright: Métier, trade, skilled labour; usually, however, regarded as a card of nobility, aristocracy, renown, glory.
waite_reversed: Mediocrity, in work and otherwise, puerility, pettiness, weakness.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Material Works
waite_additional_upright: If for a man, celebrity for his eldest son.

name: Four of Pentacles
waite_upright: The surety of possessions, cleaving to that which one has, gift, legacy, inheritance.
waite_reversed: Suspense, delay, opposition.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Earthly Power
waite_additional_upright: For a bachelor, pleasant news from a lady.

name: Five of Pentacles
waite_upright: The card foretells material trouble above all, whether in the form illustrated—that is, destitution—or otherwise. For some cartomancists, it is a card of love and lovers—wife, husband, friend, mistress; also concordance, affinities. These alternatives cannot be harmonized.
waite_reversed: Disorder, chaos, ruin, discord, profligacy.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Material Trouble
waite_additional_upright: Conquest of fortune by reason.

name: Six of Pentacles
waite_upright: Presents, gifts, gratification; another account says attention, vigilance; now is the accepted time, present prosperity, etc.
waite_reversed: Desire, cupidity, envy, jealousy, illusion.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Material Success
waite_additional_upright: The present must not be relied on.
waite_additional_reversed: A check on the Querent's ambition.

name: Seven of Pentacles
waite_upright: These are exceedingly contradictory; in the main, it is a card of money, business, barter; but one reading gives altercation, quarrel—and another innocence, ingenuity, purgation.
waite_reversed: Cause for anxiety regarding money which it may be proposed to lend.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Success Unfulfilled
waite_additional_upright: Improved position for a lady's future husband.

name: Eight of Pentacles
waite_upright: Work, employment, commission, craftsmanship, skill in craft and business, perhaps in the preparatory stage.
waite_reversed: Voided ambition, vanity, cupidity, exaction, usury. It may also signify the possession of skill, in the sense of the ingenious mind turned to cunning and intrigue.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Prudence
waite_additional_upright: A young man in business who has relations with the Querent; a dark girl.
waite_additional_reversed: The Querent will be compromised in a matter of money-lending.

name: Nine of Pentacles
waite_upright: Prudence, safety, success, accomplishment, certitude, discernment.
waite_reversed: Roguery, deception, voided project, bad faith.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Material Gain
waite_additional_upright: Prompt fulfilment of what is presaged by neighbouring cards.

name: Ten of Pentacles
waite_upright: Gain, riches; family matters, archives, extraction, the abode of a family.
waite_reversed: Chance, fatality, loss, robbery, games of hazard; sometimes gift, dowry, pension.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of Wealth
waite_additional_upright: Represents house or dwelling, and derives its value from other cards.
waite_additional_reversed: An occasion which may be fortunate or otherwise.

name: Page of Pentacles
waite_upright: Application, study, scholarship, reflection; another reading says news, messages and the bringer thereof; also rule, management.
waite_reversed: Prodigality, dissipation, liberality, luxury; unfavourable news.
golden_dawn_title: The Princess of the Echoing Hills; the Rose of the Palace of Earth
waite_additional_upright: A dark youth; a young officer or soldier; a child.

name: Knight of Pentacles
waite_upright: Utility, serviceableness, interest, responsibility, rectitude—all on the normal and external plane.
waite_reversed: inertia, idleness, repose of that kind, stagnation; also placidity, discouragement, carelessness.
golden_dawn_title: The Lord of the Wide and Fertile Land; the King of the Spirits of Earth
waite_additional_upright: An useful man; useful discoveries.
waite_additional_reversed: A brave man out of employment.

name: Queen of Pentacles
waite_upright: Opulence, generosity, magnificence, security, liberty.
waite_reversed: Evil, suspicion, suspense, fear, mistrust.
golden_dawn_title: The Queen of the Thrones of Earth
waite_additional_upright: Dark woman; presents from a rich relative; rich and happy marriage for a young man.

name: King of Pentacles
waite_upright: Valour, realizing intelligence, business and normal intellectual aptitude, sometimes mathematical gifts and attainments of this kind; success in these paths.
waite_reversed: Vice, weakness, ugliness, perversity, corruption, peril.
golden_dawn_title: The Prince of the Chariot of Earth
waite_additional_upright: A rather dark man, a merchant, master, professor.
